title: 山屋惊魂教程交易段当前通过图组

requirements.requirement: 教程交易段必须按真实流程承接：同房间可交易 -> 点交易 -> 选己方给出物 -> 选同房队友 -> 选对方给出物 -> 提交方案 -> 等接收方同意 -> 公开转移结果。
evidence: E2E: node scripts/infra/run-e2e-command.mjs isolated e2e/betrayal/betrayal-tutorial.e2e.ts --grep "交易教程会选双方持有物、提交方案后等待队友正式自动同意" => 1 passed
screenshots: evidence/betrayal-tutorial/13-山屋惊魂-教程-交易同房间说明.jpg through 18-山屋惊魂-教程-交易自动同意公开结果.jpg

requirements.requirement: 交易确认语义必须是双边提案：发起方提交方案后不转移持有物，接收方同意后才结算；教程不得要求当前玩家切视角或替队友点同意。
evidence: tutorial E2E asserts waiting state after proposal and no visible receiver agreement panel on the current player page
tutorial text: requestWaiting says receiver agrees through the formal trade response, without switching viewpoint or clicking for teammate

requirements.requirement: 交易横幅必须简化：顶部只显示一行状态，方案详情和提交/同意/拒绝操作必须在底部同一操作层。
evidence: formal trade E2E: node scripts/infra/run-e2e-command.mjs isolated e2e/betrayal/first-scenario-trade-interaction.e2e.ts --grep "交易|横幅|方案|同意" => 6 passed
Board DOM contract: betrayal-trade-flow-banner uses data-trade-progress-visible="status-only"; proposal details are under betrayal-trade-action-panel

requirements.requirement: 教程卡不得遮挡本步骤要读或点击的交易主体，包括急救包、地图 token、对方持有物候选、提交方案按钮和等待横幅。
evidence: tutorial E2E expectTutorialCardDoesNotCoverTargets checks trade action, medical kit, teammate token, return selector, map card, trade banner
screenshot 14 was regenerated after moving choose-trade-item tooltip to the right of the inventory card

requirements.requirement: 本轮展示图组必须只包含当前通过的交易截图，不混入旧的 18/19 或 29/35 历史图。
evidence: label sequence output contains exactly 00-sequence-index.png plus six NN-labeled images generated from the current six source screenshots
